codes.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts – try again in a few minutes.
codes.PASSWORD_LOGIN_DISABLED: Password sign-in is disabled – please use single sign-on.
codes.SSO_VAULT_LOCKED: Single sign-on is not available until an administrator unlocks the vault.
codes.SAME_PASSWORD: Choose a password different from the current one.
codes.PASSWORD_POLICY: The password needs at least 10 characters, with letters and at least one digit or symbol.
codes.LAST_ADMIN: At least one active administrator is required.
codes.SSO_MANAGED_PROFILE: Name and e-mail of this account are managed by single sign-on.
codes.PASSPHRASE_TOO_SHORT: The master passphrase needs at least 12 characters.
codes.SAME_PASSPHRASE: Choose a passphrase different from the current one.
codes.VAULT_MISMATCH: The vault file does not belong to this database – restore the matching vault.json.
codes.VAULT_CHANGE_INTERRUPTED: A change of the master passphrase was interrupted – unlock with the new passphrase.
codes.PLATFORM_CONFIG_UNVERIFIED: The connection settings of this platform were changed outside Steward. No requests are sent until an administrator reviews and confirms them on the platform page.
codes.SSO_CONFIG_UNVERIFIED: The settings of this sign-in provider were changed outside Steward. An administrator has to review and save them again.
codes.ANCHOR_INVALID: This is not a checkpoint (expected the JSON of a checkpoint, or seq:hash).
codes.ANCHOR_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The checkpoint's signature is invalid – it was changed or comes from another installation.
codes.BUSY: Too many sign-ins at the same time – try again in a moment.
codes.PDF_NOT_DERIVED: This PDF is not derived from a PDF Steward generated for this record. Sign a PDF generated here and upload the signed file unchanged.
codes.PDF_NOT_SIGNED: This is the unsigned PDF exactly as Steward generated it – sign it first.
codes.PDF_NO_SIGNATURE: The file starts with a PDF generated for this record, but no signature was added.
codes.RECORD_CHANGED: Someone changed this record in the meantime. Reload the page and apply your changes again.
